items.source: If rendering, flush any buffered BodyContent or, if no BodyContent is supplied, render the default content.
items.translation: 如果正在rendering，则刷新任何缓冲的BodyContent，或者如果没有提供BodyContent，则渲染默认内容。

items.source: Called during writeTagContent(TagWriter) allowing subclasses to add any attributes to the PageContext as needed.
items.translation: 在调用writeTagContent(TagWriter)期间，允许子类根据需要向PageContext添加任何属性。

items.source: Called by doFinally() allowing subclasses to remove any attributes from the PageContext as needed.
items.translation: 由doFinally()调用，允许子类根据需要从PageContext中移除任何属性。

items.source: Called at the start of writeTagContent(TagWriter) allowing subclasses to perform any precondition checks or setup tasks that might be necessary.
items.translation: 在调用writeTagContent(TagWriter)之前执行，允许子类执行任何必要的预检查或设置任务。

items.source: The default implementation simply flushes the BodyContent directly to the output. Subclasses may choose to override this to add additional content to the output.
items.translation: 默认实现只是将BodyContentflushes直接输出到输出流。子类可以选择重写此方法，以向输出添加额外内容。

items.source: Convenient superclass for many html tags that render content using the databinding features of the AbstractHtmlElementTag. The only thing sub-tags need to do is override renderDefaultContent(TagWriter).
items.translation: 适用于许多使用 `AbstractHtmlElementTag` 的数据绑定功能来渲染内容的 HTML 标签的便捷父类。子标签唯一需要做的就是重写 renderDefaultContent(TagWriter)。

items.source: Description copied from class: AbstractFormTag
items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractFormTag

items.source: The user customised the output of the error messages - flush the buffered content into the main JspWriter.
items.translation: 用户自定义了错误消息的输出——将缓冲内容刷新到主 `<code>JspWriter` 中。

items.source: Should rendering of this tag proceed at all. Returns 'true' by default causing rendering to occur always, Subclasses can override this if they provide conditional rendering.
items.translation: 该标签是否应进行渲染。默认返回 `true`，导致始终进行渲染；子类若提供条件渲染，可重写此方法。

items.source: Clean up any attributes and stored resources.
items.translation: 清理所有属性和存储资源。

items.source: Subclasses should implement this method to perform tag content rendering.
items.translation: 子类应实现此方法以执行标签内容渲染。
